E404.description: Not found or no access (never 403 for crew entities)

E422.description: Validation error, reserved sender or cross-crew id

Actor.description: Derived by the server from the credential (session token, JWT or system), never from the payload.
Actor.title: Actor

ClientEvent.description: Item of POST /crews/{id}/events. Actor and session come from the session token, never the body.

id.description: client event id; stored as idem key 'c:<id>'

ClientEvent.title: ClientEvent

subject.description: repo-relative path, zone slug or resource

error.description: report_required | claim_cap | session_exists | conflict | frozen | protected | crew_policy | …

CrewSnapshot.description: GET /crews/{id}/snapshot. Live claims only; decisions are proposed + in_force.
CrewSnapshot.title: CrewSnapshot

anyOf.description: argv-prefix pattern matched against observed commands; never executed
fetched only by the server SSRF-safe fetcher

summary.description: server template; ids, slugs and callsigns only

FootprintView.description: Dirty/committed footprints of live sessions (not landed); feeds guard rows 5 and 16.
FootprintView.title: FootprintView

host_label.description: salted label, never the raw hostname

source.description: startup | resume | clear | compact | mcp | cli

LastAction.description: Command metadata only (verb, classified target); never a raw command string (§11).
LastAction.title: LastAction

toplevel.description: absolute path on this host; never leaves the host

LocalSnapshot.description: ~/.remembra/crew/snapshot/<crew>.json written by crewd (atomic rename). HMAC is tamper evidence only.
LocalSnapshot.title: LocalSnapshot

McpToolRule.description: Zone mapping of an MCP tool-name pattern (only '*' wildcards) to the zone itself or to a service.
McpToolRule.title: McpToolRule

WsCrewSummary.description: Counts only; filtered by project_ids for restricted keys; never replays events.
WsCrewSummary.title: WsCrewSummary

WsPresence.description: Ephemeral; no seq; never replayed; ≤1 per session per 5 s.
WsPresence.title: WsPresence

info.description: Generated from remembra.crew.schemas.ROUTES. Do not edit by hand; see docs/crew/rest-api.md.
info.title: Remembra Crew API (contract stubs)

post.summary: Offer a claim to a session
Revoke, transfer or hold a claim
Join (creates the crew lazily for a key allowed on the project)
Resolve a crew by project_id or locator (read-only; never creates)
The adopter's crewd reports restoring the baton ref (crew session token; once)

get.summary: List bypass codes (ids, scope, session, state; never the code)

post.summary: Claim a zone, glob or resource
Create a task from a handoff
Create a server zone (loosening changes are H)

put.summary: Upload compiled zones.yml → applied or pending

post.summary: Add an email or signed-webhook target
Confirm an email target with the mailed code
Share a project with a team
Release all claims of a session
Release a task (optionally as a baton)
Start a task (claims its zones atomically)

get.summary: Trail includes crew checkpoints, reports and batons

patch.summary: Patch a zone (repo zones return an export patch)
